moments.text: Dark infrared view: steeply tilted horizon bar, crosshair, angle readout, irregular black redaction boxes. A bright cloud edge at upper right fades by 3 s.
A small bright dot emerges from the redaction near the top edge, left of centre, and drifts slowly right until a black box covers it.
The crosshair keeps turning into a small box that grows to a large frame, then back. Faint one-pixel specks drift near it around 7.5–9.5 s.
An arrow symbol appears upper left. At 25.3 s the redaction grows; a diamond marker, then a box, appear, with a readout falling from 72M.
The box shrinks to a tiny two-bar reticle below the centre circle as the horizon bar levels; the readout keeps falling to 50M.
The picture flickers dark, banded, then bright.
Two tall bars open around a faint dot at centre; the readout jumps to 398M, then 386M.
Another flicker, then a grainier picture: the bars spread to the frame edges and the readout drops to 81M, then 77M.
The bars snap back to the usual brackets with a diamond marker; the readout counts down from about 280M to 220M.
The markers vanish and the picture goes black for half a second, leaving only the horizon bar and angle readout.
Plain crosshair over the grainy background as the angle readout climbs from -14° to -25°, with a banded flash at 54.3 s. No object visible.

notes: Low-resolution 640x480 source; the objects the summary describes are at most one-pixel specks, mostly unresolvable. Full-frame recheck: added the bright dot drifting along the top edge 2.5-23 s (cropped out before).
